# Driver evidence and limitations

<!-- Generated by buddy docs:native-skills from capabilityRegistry. -->

The registry distinguishes supported, partial, experimental, and unsupported
drivers. Unknown and unsupported selections fail. Partial and experimental
drivers remain subject to the limitations below. Read prerequisites before
deploying; a configuration type does not establish an implemented transport.

## database: sqlite

Status: **supported**. Topology: embedded.

Implementation: [storage/framework/core/database/src/drivers/sqlite.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/database/src/drivers/sqlite.ts).

Prerequisites:

- Bun SQLite

Retained evidence:

- [storage/framework/core/database/tests/integration.test.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/database/tests/integration.test.ts)

## database: mysql

Status: **supported**. Topology: client-server.

Implementation: [storage/framework/core/database/src/drivers/mysql.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/database/src/drivers/mysql.ts).

Prerequisites:

- MySQL 26.7 service

Limitations:

- The migration files shipped under database/migrations are emitted for a single dialect (SQLite in the default template) and do not replay on MySQL. Regenerate them against MySQL (`buddy generate:migrations`) before migrating.

Retained evidence:

- [storage/framework/core/database/tests/integration.test.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/database/tests/integration.test.ts)

## database: vitess

Status: **experimental**. Topology: mysql-behind-vtgate.

Implementation: [storage/framework/core/database/src/drivers/mysql.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/database/src/drivers/mysql.ts).

Prerequisites:

- A Vitess cluster reachable at vtgate

Limitations:

- No live cluster in CI; the retained evidence covers unsharded and sharded DDL profiles plus VSchema generation, not a round trip through vtgate.
- Set DB_VITESS_SHARDED=true for a sharded keyspace; those keyspaces reject cross-shard foreign keys and AUTO_INCREMENT, so use application-generated IDs and a VSchema.
- Schema changes on sharded keyspaces should go through Vitess online DDL.
- A transaction spanning shards is best-effort or two-phase, not the single-node ACID the ORM assumes.

Retained evidence:

- [storage/framework/core/database/tests/vitess-constraints.test.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/database/tests/vitess-constraints.test.ts)

## database: turso

Status: **experimental**. Topology: managed-service.

Implementation: [storage/framework/core/database/src/dialect.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/database/src/dialect.ts).

Prerequisites:

- A Turso database (TURSO_DATABASE_URL, TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN), or a local libSQL server from `turso dev` / sqld

Limitations:

- Proven against a local sqld 0.24.32 (turso CLI 1.0.33 `turso dev`), not a hosted Turso database, and no libSQL service runs in CI yet, so the retained evidence skips its live half there.
- SQLite SQL over Hrana HTTP: each statement outside a transaction is one request, and a transaction holds one server stream for its duration.
- sqld refuses VACUUM, ATTACH, temporary tables and every PRAGMA except the read-only ones and foreign_keys.
- Embedded replicas are not supported; the connection is always remote.
- Inside transaction(), write through the tx handle: model writes use their own connection, as on PostgreSQL and MySQL, and wait while the transaction holds the write lock.
- Scheduler onOneServer() locks stay per-host, as they are on SQLite.
- `buddy db:backup` does not dump a Turso database; rely on Turso's own point-in-time restore.

Retained evidence:

- [storage/framework/core/database/tests/turso.test.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/database/tests/turso.test.ts)

## storage: azure

Status: **partial**. Topology: managed-object-storage.

Implementation: [storage/framework/core/storage/src/adapters/azure.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/storage/src/adapters/azure.ts).

Prerequisites:

- An Azure storage account, a container, and an account key or SAS token

Limitations:

- CI covers Shared Key and service-SAS signing plus request construction, not a live container round trip.
- Visibility is a container property on Azure, so changeVisibility() refuses rather than silently doing nothing; a per-object grant is signedUrl().
- ensureConfiguredBuckets provisions S3 buckets only, so the container must exist before the disk is used.

Retained evidence:

- [storage/framework/core/storage/tests/azure-adapter.test.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/storage/tests/azure-adapter.test.ts)
- [storage/framework/core/storage/tests/azure-signing.test.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/storage/tests/azure-signing.test.ts)

## deploy: ts-cloud-hetzner

Status: **experimental**. Topology: hetzner-vm-systemd-rpx.

Implementation: [storage/framework/core/buddy/src/commands/deploy.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/buddy/src/commands/deploy.ts).

Prerequisites:

- @stacksjs/ts-cloud
- Hetzner credentials
- SSH key

Limitations:

- Live provider evidence and rollback conformance are not yet retained in the protocol report.

Retained evidence:

- [storage/framework/core/buddy/tests/deploy-ssh-target.test.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/buddy/tests/deploy-ssh-target.test.ts)

## deploy: ts-cloud-ssh

Status: **experimental**. Topology: ssh-box-systemd-rpx.

Implementation: [storage/framework/core/buddy/src/commands/deploy-ssh-target.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/buddy/src/commands/deploy-ssh-target.ts).

Prerequisites:

- @stacksjs/ts-cloud with the ssh driver
- A 64-bit Debian or Ubuntu host reachable over SSH
- Passwordless sudo when deploying as a non-root user

Limitations:

- DNS, TLS issuance, CDN and mail reconciliation are skipped for a host on a private address.
- One app host per project; multi-host ssh fleets are not supported.
- No live hardware evidence is retained in CI.

Retained evidence:

- [storage/framework/core/buddy/tests/deploy-ssh-target.test.ts](https://github.com/stacksjs/stacks/blob/main/storage/framework/core/buddy/tests/deploy-ssh-target.test.ts)

## Optional application bundles

Installable bundle names: `dashboard`, `commerce`, `cms`, `forms`, `marketing`, `monitoring`, `realtime`, `queue`.

Read `stacks-features` for installation, config gates, route bundles, and
migration selection. These are distinct from user-targeted feature flags.
